cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start in laboratory and field testing. Your Dandenong team does laboratory testing and field investigations for geotechnical and civil projects, and that's the kind of technician work I want to get into.

In the diploma I studied the AS 1289 soil testing standards and kept technical records as part of the civil design work. On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote up the results. I have a Victorian driver's licence and a White Card.

I can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
notes: Full-time six-month fixed-term field and laboratory technician role in Dandenong. Training provided; the employer portal lists the job level as entry/early careers. Driver's licence and White Card held (the advert asks for a Construction Industry Card). SEEK apply links out to the Tonkin+Taylor careers page. Portal close date 18 Dec 2026. No Gmail receipt for this listing. Fit 90 (50 + 25 entry + 15 duty + 10 lane 2).
verify_before_submit: Confirm the advert is still open and still a full-time field and laboratory technician role in Dandenong
The role is a six-month fixed-term contract; do not describe it as permanent
Construction Industry Card (CIC): treat as the White Card (held); if the form means a different card, stop and report
Driver's licence is essential and is on record; do not claim a manual licence (automatic only)
Do not claim paid laboratory or field testing experience
